Rectangle $ABCD$ has $AB=5$ and $BC=4$. Point $E$ lies on $\overline{AB}$ so that $EB=1$, point $G$ lies on $\overline{BC}$ so that $CG=1$. and point $F$ lies on $\overline{CD}$ so that $DF=2$. Segments $\overline{AG}$ and $\overline{AC}$ intersect $\overline{EF}$ at $Q$ and $P$, respectively. What is the value of $\frac{PQ}{EF}$?

method.method_draft: Use similarity and fractional position along EF without assigning full coordinates. Let r be the fraction of EF measured upward from F, so a point on EF at fraction r has vertical height 4r above CD. Along EF, the horizontal distance from AD changes linearly from DF=2 at F to AE=4 at E, so the horizontal distance from AD is 2+2r. For P on diagonal AC, similar triangles in the rectangle give the horizontal distance from AD at height 4r as 5(1-r). Equating 2+2r=5(1-r) gives r_P=3/7. For Q on AG, the total vertical drop from A to G is 3 and the horizontal run is 5; at height 4r, the drop from A is 4-4r, so by similar triangles the horizontal distance from AD is (5/3)(4-4r). Equating 2+2r=(5/3)(4-4r) gives r_Q=7/13. Therefore PQ/EF = r_Q-r_P = 7/13-3/7 = 10/91.

Let r be the fraction of the way along EF measured upward from F to E. Since the rectangle has height BC = 4, a point on EF at fraction r has vertical height 4r above CD. Along EF, the horizontal distance from AD changes linearly from DF = 2 at F to AE = AB - EB = 5 - 1 = 4 at E. Therefore the horizontal distance from AD for a point on EF is 2 + 2r.

For P on diagonal AC, similar triangles in the rectangle show that at height 4r above CD, the horizontal distance from AD is 5(1 - r). Since P is also on EF, set 2 + 2r = 5(1 - r). Then 2 + 2r = 5 - 5r, so 7r = 3, giving r_P = 3/7.

For Q on AG, point G is 1 unit above C, so the vertical drop from A to G is 4 - 1 = 3, while the horizontal run is 5. At height 4r above CD, the vertical drop from A is 4 - 4r. By similar triangles, the horizontal distance from AD is (5/3)(4 - 4r). Since Q is also on EF, set 2 + 2r = (5/3)(4 - 4r). Multiplying by 3 gives 6 + 6r = 20 - 20r, so 26r = 14, giving r_Q = 7/13.

Because distance along EF is proportional to the fractional parameter r, PQ/EF = r_Q - r_P = 7/13 - 3/7 = 49/91 - 39/91 = 10/91.
